bound_formula: 1400*(1+.054)/1.7 * cap^(-1.7); GCCLY factor and meson denominators <=1; Etotal>=K; charge fractions sum1
bound_scope: Incident flux all energies above source cutoff, all zenith angles. For fixed-path energy-only number-conserving transport, transmitted contribution cannot exceed this incident integral. This is a physical-domain bound, not a guarantee for a biased MC implementation.
mc_control_interpretation: Changing a transport ceiling changes random-number consumption and later histories even at identical seed. Estimates share prefixes and subsequently diverge; the descriptive quadrature of reported SE is not an independence assumption or calibrated z-test, and these differences do not directly estimate the physical tail.
